about: Graph examples for Graph > Add > Examples, read by the desktop (Logic/GraphExamples.cs) and the web app (web/app/src/lib/examples.ts). defaults: the constants and their values, in the form's order; Use writes them into the form as numbers. view: a function's thumbnail range [minX, maxX, minY, maxY]; half: an equation's half height around the origin (4:3, so circles stay round). Every one was drawn through the engine before it went in (owner 2026-11-10; shared 2026-11-19).

functions.title: Parabola
functions.name: parabola
functions.note: vertex at (h, k); a = width, a<0 opens down

functions.title: Cubic
functions.name: cubic
functions.note: b>0: two bumps at x=±√(b/3); b≤0: none; k = y offset

functions.title: Absolute value
functions.name: vshape
functions.note: corner at (h, k); a = slope of the arms

functions.title: Hyperbola 1/x
functions.name: hyperbola
functions.note: asymptotes x=h, y=k; a<0 flips quadrants

functions.title: Sine
functions.name: sine
functions.note: a = amplitude; period 2π/b; c = phase shift; d = mid line

functions.title: Cosine
functions.name: cosine
functions.note: a = amplitude; period 2π/b; c = phase shift; d = mid line

functions.title: Tangent
functions.name: tangent
functions.note: period π/b; c = shift; a = stretch

functions.title: Exponential
functions.name: growth
functions.note: y = a+k at x=0; b<0 decays; asymptote y=k

functions.title: Natural log
functions.name: logarithm
functions.note: asymptote x=h; passes (h+1, k); a = stretch

functions.title: Bell curve
functions.name: bell
functions.note: a = peak; m = centre; s = width (bends at m±s)

functions.title: Sigmoid
functions.name: sigmoid
functions.note: L = top level; k = steepness; m = midpoint, where y = L/2

functions.title: Witch of Agnesi
functions.name: agnesi
functions.note: a = radius of the circle that draws it; peak 2a

functions.title: x sin(1/x)
functions.name: wobble
functions.note: n=0: no limit at 0; n=1: squeezed to 0; n=2: smooth at 0

functions.title: Two waves
functions.name: waves
functions.note: a = second wave height; b = its frequency

equations.title: Ellipse
equations.note: centre (h, k); a = half width; b = half height

equations.title: Sideways parabola
equations.note: vertex (h, k); focus p to the right; p<0 opens left

equations.title: Heart
equations.note: a = height of the lobes; a=0 is a circle

equations.title: Superellipse
equations.note: a = half width; b = half height; n=2 ellipse, n>2 squarer, n=1 diamond, n<1 star

equations.title: Cassini oval
equations.note: foci (±a, 0); b<a: two ovals, b=a: lemniscate, b>a: one

equations.title: Devil's curve
equations.note: crosses the y axis at ±a, the x axis at ±b; a=b: lines y = ±x and a circle

equations.title: Egg crate
equations.note: c=0: grid of lines, 0<c<1: eggs, |c|>1: nothing; cell size π/b

equations.title: x^y = y^x
equations.note: no constant: the line y = x and a curve crossing it at (e, e); passes (2, 4)
